# Chadstone Redbacks Lacrosse Club

> A welcoming, family-friendly lacrosse club in Malvern East, Melbourne, Australia, established 1960. We run junior, women's and men's programs and describe lacrosse as "the fastest game on two feet". New players — especially juniors — are always welcome, with no experience needed.

## Key facts
- Location: Percy Treyvaud Reserve, 32A Chadstone Rd, Malvern East VIC 3145, Australia.
- Founded: 1960 (originally "the Cardinals").
- Programs: Junior (boys & girls, U10–U18), Women's (plays as "Chadfield", combined with Caulfield), Men's (social to State League).
- Training: Tuesday & Thursday, 5–8pm at Percy Treyvaud Reserve.
- Junior "come & try": free, Thursdays 5:30–6:30pm. Contact junior coordinator James Conheady on 0407 705 367.
- 2026/27 fees (club fee): Senior Men $400, Senior Women $290, U18 Boys $260, U17 Girls $220, U16 Boys $205, U14 $190, U12 $165, U10 $60. Plus a free Lacrosse Victoria registration.
- Registration platform: GameDay. Governing body: Lacrosse Victoria.
- Contact: info@chadstonelacrosse.com.au · recruitment@chadstonelacrosse.com.au · treasurer 0439 444 535.
